ci: run default and testnet test lanes on pull requests and main pushes
Contributed by Ziyang (as exfer-stack) upstream to ahuman-exfer/exfer, the Exfer chain itself.
https://github.com/ahuman-exfer/exfer/pull/40

The agreed follow-up from PR #34 — "The CI testnet test job remains the agreed follow-up so these pins can't rot."

One workflow, one matrix, two lanes, on `pull_request` to main and `push` to main:

- `cargo test` (default features)
- `cargo test --features testnet` — the lane where the fix-8 orphan-rate pins and the devnet sig-domain roundtrip live

Tests only by design: no `fmt --check`, no clippy — nothing that would fail on current main or impose a discipline the repo hasn't adopted. Measured warm on a dev box: default lane ~1m00, testnet lane ~2m21 (the devnet roundtrip integration test accounts for ~18s and runs headless on a runner — it spawns local node processes on loopback only). Pinned actions (`checkout@v4`, `dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable`, `Swatinem/rust-cache@v2` keyed per lane), `permissions: contents: read`, 60-minute timeout.
